title: Check and Top Up Coolant
summary: Coolant keeps the engine from overheating. Check it cold, never open a hot radiator cap.

learn.heading: What you're looking at
learn.body: Coolant (antifreeze mixed with water) flows through the engine and radiator. You'll find a translucent overflow reservoir with MIN and MAX marks — that's the safe check point on most cars. The radiator cap sits on the radiator itself, but you rarely need to open it for a routine check.

learn.heading: What can hurt you
learn.body: Opening a hot radiator cap releases pressurized boiling fluid — severe burns. Always check the overflow reservoir when the engine is cold. Coolant is toxic to pets and kids; wipe spills and don't drain it on the ground. Never mix incompatible coolant types.
learn.callout: If the reservoir is empty, there may be a leak. Topping up without finding the leak is a band-aid.

learn.heading: The steps
learn.body:
1. Engine cold — sat overnight is best.
2. Pop the hood and find the coolant overflow reservoir.
3. Check the level against the MIN/MAX marks on the side.
4. If low, remove the reservoir cap and add the correct coolant mix (check owner's manual — usually 50/50).
5. Fill to between MIN and MAX. Don't overfill.
6. Replace cap snugly. Wipe any spills.
7. If it keeps dropping, look for leaks at hoses and the radiator.

practice.prompt: Spot the hazards in this coolant check.

hazards.label: Opening radiator cap on a hot engine
Pouring plain water into a system that needs antifreeze mix

practice.failMessage: Hot cap = burn risk. Wrong fluid = freeze or corrosion damage.

practice.prompt: Reservoir is below MIN but the engine is still warm from a drive. What do you do?

options.text: Wait until the engine is completely cool, then top up the reservoir
Open the radiator cap now to fill faster
options.feedback: Pressurized hot coolant will spray. Wait for cold.

options.text: Drive to the store for coolant with the engine running
options.feedback: Low coolant plus heat makes overheating worse. Let it cool first.

practice.failMessage: Cool engine first. The reservoir cap is safe when cold; the system isn't under pressure.

practice.prompt: Tap where you check coolant on a routine basis.
practice.failMessage: Routine check is the overflow reservoir with MIN/MAX marks — not oil or brake fluid.
